title: Addy Osmani (@addyosmani) on X
comment: While more constraints usually means better results (correctness, code quality), the article argues about adjusting the constaints to your actual throughput. E.g. if Back-pressure is too high by agents creating too many human-review-needed tasks, create more constraints to reduce that effort. If too less back pressure, reduce the required quality gates of the agentic setup
